content.raw: Nit: pull the 64KB literal into `src/server/config.ts` as `MAX_NOTE_BYTES`. That way NTL-153 (Obsidian import) can reference the same constant when we sanity-check imports.
The `x-notely-note-too-large` custom header should probably be documented in `docs/api/errors.md`. Otherwise the mobile client folks are going to trip on it in a month.
@ava good call, extracted → `MAX_NOTE_BYTES = 64 * 1024`. @diego added a `## Note too large` section to errors.md in the same commit.
